title: 2.5.12 A16.1 Persistent High Scores
description: Bolt a persistent top-3 high-score system onto your W15 game using storeItem, JSON, and clearStorage. Auto-graded.

steps.title: Read saved high scores on game start
steps.instructions: Inside setup(), call getItem('highScores') to retrieve any previously saved scores. If nothing is stored yet, default to an empty array. This is where your game loads its memory from the last session.
hints: Open the q5play docs drawer and find the Storage section for getItem usage.

steps.title: Store high scores as JSON
steps.instructions: When you need to save scores, use JSON.stringify on your scores array and then pass the result to storeItem. Both calls must appear together so the data is serialized before it's written.
hints: Open the q5play docs drawer and find the JSON and Storage sections.

steps.title: Coerce stored values back to numbers
steps.instructions: When reading a score back from storage, wrap the getItem call in Number(...) or parseInt(...). getItem always returns a string — without coercion, arithmetic will concatenate instead of add.
hints: See the q5play docs drawer Storage section for the type-coercion note.

steps.title: Write a new top-3 entry only when the score qualifies
steps.instructions: Inside an if-block that checks whether the current score earns a spot in the top 3, call storeItem to save the updated list. The condition must reference score so the grader can confirm the save is gated.
hints: Open the q5play docs drawer and review the Storage section.

steps.title: Clear button wipes saved scores
steps.instructions: Inside draw(), give the player a way to reset all saved scores — call clearStorage() or removeItem('highScores') when a key is pressed. This lets you demo persistence: save scores, close the tab, reopen, then press the clear key to reset.
hints: Open the q5play docs drawer and find the Storage section for clearStorage and removeItem.

steps.title: Background cleared each frame
steps.instructions: Inside draw(), call background(...) so old frames do not pile up on screen. This should already be in your W15 game.
hints: Search the q5play docs drawer for background().
